title: ReStuff
description: a useless camera that has no use in life
body:
In this mod, I made a useless camera that literally has no use, just a camera and a camera stand; the function inside it was just interaction.

## recipe

Crafting the Camera.

![craft a camera](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a1ee09494a29ea337670f855e60b2a1854585e0.png)
- 3 gray wool.
- 4 iron ingots.
- 1 redstone.
- 1 button.

Crafting the tripod legs.

![crafting the tripod legs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/221f05add8c8260da2bbeb63052f23a66848043f.png)
- 1 gray wool.
- 1 iron ingot.

Crafting the tripod.

![crafting the tripod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3febf5f6250b09937b967ecd1f92e62b03dc96e9.png)
- 4 iron ingots.
- 1 smooth stone slab.

Combine both.

![combine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e15805a5b490347fd26f68cf7ddc628e260bb67.png)

Put both the camera and the tripod.

## how to use
1. Place the tripods or the camera stand.
2. Hold the camera, then right-click the tripod. Or you can just throw the camera on the tripod, or just craft it.
3. You can take the camera off by shift and right-click
